text:
Kyoto's December lantern path ended after 2021.
What Kyoto does now is better 👇

🔔 Guess how many monks ring Chion-in's bell 👉 https://japanbystation.com/kyoto-in-december-2026

🍲 7–8 Dec: Senbon Shakado
serves radish stew for ¥1,000, 10:00–16:00.

🛍️ 21 Dec: Toji's market, 8:00–15:00.
🛍️ 25 Dec: Kitano Tenmangu, from 6:30.

🔔 31 Dec: at Chion-in, 17 monks
swing a log at a 70-tonne bell.
Watching is by application, ¥3,000.

🙌 Ring one yourself?
Kodaiji gives out 108 tickets from 22:00.

👉 Kyoto's oldest working bell, and where to hear it:
https://japanbystation.com/kyoto-in-december-2026

Would you queue to ring a bell at midnight? 🔔
